boundary: BF16 Dispatch -> grouped FC1 gate/up; FP32 accumulation, BF16 output; router and activation excluded
scope: EP4 255 physical points; EP8 remains historical v26.0, not remeasured
measurement: Graph 10 warmups + 50 samples per reproducible nonzero payload, two payloads, mean of max-rank p50; full numerical/routing/tail validation
selection_limits: Finite offline GEMM and CTA-budget winners, not global optimality or production Auto. M<192 budget winners lack full independent replay; M>=192 uses independent winner replay. Historical full148SM reference is not same-run A/B.
overhead_method: Median of 3 same-configuration light profiles: max(compute CTA end)-max(compute CTA end-first ready wait) on the critical local-role rank. Fixed-duration sensitivity estimate, not guaranteed recoverable time or a hardware bound.
